summary: Flush one pending batch by key and deliver consolidated summary.

input_schema.batch_key: string | The batch key to flush.
input_schema.actor: string | optional | Actor identity for routing context. Defaults to 'operator'.
input_schema.channel: string | optional | Channel identifier. Defaults to service routing default.
input_schema.title: string | optional | Optional title for flushed summary notification.

output_schema.decision: string | Router decision outcome: sent or suppressed.
output_schema.delivered: boolean | Whether a message was delivered to channel.
output_schema.suppressed_reason: string | optional | Suppression reason when no batch is available.
output_schema.batched_count: integer | optional | Pending item count when relevant.
output_schema.notification: object | optional | Normalized routed notification payload.
